item.title: Trump voices frustration with NATO, says Iranian navy ‘destroyed’ as US preps for blockade
item.summary: President Trump said Iran’s navy has been destroyed and confirms a sweeping oil blockade, while sharply criticizing NATO allies and warning U.S. support for the alliance faces scrutiny.

item.title: Trump accuses Pope Leo of being 'terrible' on foreign policy over pontiff's anti-war comments
item.summary: President Donald Trump accused Pope Leo XIV of being "terrible" on foreign policy as the pontiff continues to criticize the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran and call for peace.

item.title: Senate Democrat avoids answering whether Swalwell should resign from Congress
item.summary: Sen. Mark Warner declined to say whether Rep. Eric Swalwell should resign from Congress amid sexual misconduct allegations from multiple women Sunday.

item.title: ‘Gate of Tears’ at risk: Iran threatens major new global chokepoint if US moves on Hormuz
item.summary: Senior Middle East advisor warns Iran could use Houthi proxies to blockade the Bab al-Mandeb strait if the U.S. blocks the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Bruce Springsteen's former drummer pushes back on the Boss's political attacks on Trump: 'Gotta have respect'
item.summary: Bruce Springsteen's former drummer Vini Lopez speaks out against the Boss's anti-Trump rhetoric, saying everyone should respect the president.

item.title: JD Vance returns to Washington after 16 hours of Iran peace talks collapse in Pakistan
item.summary: Vice President JD Vance's marathon negotiations with Iranian officials in Islamabad failed to produce a deal, prompting President Donald Trump to order a Strait of Hormuz blockade.

item.title: Starving toddler ate diapers and drywall before dying in filthy room while parents lived clean, police say
item.summary: An Indiana couple was arrested and hit with neglect and murder charges after their starving toddler died from eating diapers and drywall to survive.

item.title: Eric Swalwell exits California governor race apologizing for past judgment while denying claims
item.summary: Rep. Eric Swalwell dropped his bid for California governor after a growing number of Democrats called on him to step aside following a bombshell report.

item.title: Dinghy route taken by missing American woman and jailed husband recreated as details of disappearance emerge
item.summary: Brian Hooker remains in a Freeport, Bahamas jail as police investigate the disappearance of his wife off Elbow Cay.

item.title: Snubbed by Trump, GOP candidates fighting for re-election act like they have his backing anyway
item.summary: Republican incumbents facing primary challenges are leaning into Trump imagery in campaign ads, even when the president has endorsed their rivals.
